import ctypes, json, os, signal, sys
from pathlib import Path
pid, parent = map(int, sys.argv[1:3])
snapshot = json.loads(Path(__file__).with_name('pre-existing-processes.json').read_text())
assert pid not in snapshot['pids'], 'Refuse: process predates campaign'
lib = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/lib/libproc.dylib', use_errno=True)
info = ctypes.create_string_buffer(136)
assert lib.proc_pidinfo(pid, 3, 0, info, len(info)) == 136, 'Cannot verify parent'
assert int.from_bytes(info.raw[12:16], 'little') == pid
ppid = int.from_bytes(info.raw[16:20], 'little')
assert ppid == parent, 'Refuse: parent differs from isolated main process'
buf = ctypes.create_string_buffer(4096)
assert lib.proc_pidpath(pid, buf, len(buf)) > 0, 'Cannot verify executable'
exe = buf.value.decode()
libc = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
mib = (ctypes.c_int * 3)(1, 49, pid)
size = ctypes.c_size_t(262144)
raw = ctypes.create_string_buffer(size.value)
assert libc.sysctl(mib, 3, raw, ctypes.byref(size), None, 0) == 0, 'Cannot verify command line'
argc = int.from_bytes(raw.raw[:4], 'little')
data = raw.raw[4:size.value]
args = data[data.index(b'\0'):].lstrip(b'\0').split(b'\0')[:argc]
assert b'--acp' in args, 'Refuse: ACP flag absent'
assert any(Path(a.decode()).name == 'copilot' for a in args), 'Refuse: Copilot command absent'
assert b'/tmp/aio-lt-queue-dabff6ef/copilot-cli-home' in args, 'Refuse: isolated Copilot home absent'
os.kill(pid, signal.SIGKILL)
print(json.dumps({'pid':pid,'ppid':ppid,'executable':exe,'signal':'SIGKILL','notPreExisting':True,'copilotCommand':True,'acp':True,'isolatedHome':True}))
